author: Kim Creighton Simons
text:
I get that from Libre 3 all the time. Have to check with finger stick and Libre is always wrong. I’m not sure why and Abbott just keeps sending me replacement sensors. I’ve tried multiple different locations for the sensor and none seem to work. 

I’m wondering if there might be something about my body chemistry that causes to readings to be incorrect, but have no idea what that might be.

author: Cheryl Bush
text:
You are not alone. This happens to me as well. I am well aware of compression lows and am careful to sleep on my back or the other side. Just figured I was getting more lows because the sensor was on my thigh instead of my arm. No idea though.
My endo likes to tell me it is because I am taking too much long-acting insulin. However, when I get up to go to the bathroom, it raises 10 to 15 points within a couple of minutes. So.... I don't know.
